items.q: All of the following belong to Network theorems EXCEPT
o: Direct current
Norton's theorem
Superposition theorem
Thevenin's theorem
items.s: Every other option belongs to Network theorems. “Direct current” belongs to Basic electrical quantities, not Network theorems.

items.s: Rectifier: a circuit that converts alternating current into direct current. The other options describe Maximum power transfer, Induced emf, Faraday's law.
